description: This file defines a C# interface for a grain in an Orleans-based distributed system. The interface, IConsumerEventCountingGrain, specifies methods for starting and stopping event consumption and retrieving the count of events consumed.

classes.name: IConsumerEventCountingGrain
classes.description: Interface representing a stream consumer grain that counts consumed events. Extends IGrainWithGuidKey, indicating it's a grain identified by a GUID.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Initializes the grain to start consuming a stream identified by streamId and providerToUse.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Stops the grain from consuming the stream.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of events consumed by this grain.
